title: Critical MikroTik RouterOS Vulnerability Exposes Devices to Remote Code Execution
content_md: A critical vulnerability in MikroTik RouterOS could allow unauthenticated remote attackers to execute code on vulnerable devices or trigger a denial-of-service condition. This vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-84411, affects MikroTik RouterOS versions earlier than 7.24 and carries a CVSS v3 severity score of 9.8.
